russia_registration.mechanism: one #!extend stub per unit on its winning file: vessels_overwrite/<uid>_variants_RU_SEST.ini or aircraft_overwrite/<uid>_squadrons_RU_SEST.ini, setting Nation=Russia on the sections it names (RU_REREGISTER: every section that resolves to Soviet; RU_BY_SECTION and RU_AIRCRAFT: the sections listed, each of which must resolve to Soviet, and every Soviet section left out is explained); each stub also lists, in the target's order and with no keys, the target's other sections up to the last one it registers, because the game reads the stub first, adds a section where it first sees its header, and the Mission Editor saves a variant or squadron by its place in that order (SetupUnitNames, WriteUnitData), so the merged order stays the author's; no third-party file is copied, so every variant and squadron credit stays its author's
